arguments.value: This agreement is a 2000 deal between Integrity Incorporated and Time Life to create and co-brand the “Songs 4 Worship” series, a line of worship music compilations and companion songbooks. Integrity and Time Life jointly develop the music selection, but Integrity handles mastering rights, manufacturing, and sales to Time Life, while Time Life pays for artwork and mastering prep. The product is branded with both companies’ names and logos, and each side gets exclusive distribution rights in different markets: Time Life in general-market retail, telemarketing, catalogs, TV direct response, and its own online channels; Integrity in Christian retail, direct mail, church sales, and Christian online channels. Time Life must buy minimum quantities over the first 32 months, and both sides share mailing list data. Integrity pays royalties to Time Life on its sales, while Time Life pays royalties to Integrity on its sales. The agreement covers trademark and copyright ownership, quarterly accounting and audit rights, confidentiality, indemnification, force majeure, assignment, and dispute resolution under Tennessee law, and runs through December 31, 2004 unless extended by agreement.
